title: MCP tool set_task_priority for the leader
spec: Add an MCP tool set_task_priority(task_id, priority 0..100). Only the leader may call it; it is listed only in the leader's tools/list and the handler re-checks the role. Every call is audited.
acceptance_criteria: only the leader role can call set_task_priority; other roles get forbidden
each successful call appends an audit event
pr_body: The tool is registered in the leader tool list, so other roles never see it.

defects.note: the handler never checks that the caller is the leader; hiding the tool from tools/list is not enforcement
